National Council for Hotel Management Joint Entrance 
Examination 
 
NCHMCT JEE Syllabus for Numerical Ability and Analytical Aptitude 
 
Numerical Ability and Analytical Aptitude section of the NCHMCT JEE exam involves calculations. 
The main objective of this section is to check the mathematical skills of the candidates. Some of  
the important topics of the Numerical Ability and Analytical Aptitude section of the NCHMCT JEE 
exam are provided below. 
 
Partnership Work and Wages 
Area and Perimeter of Plane Figure Logarithms 
Time and Distance Number Systems 
Percentage Fractions and Decimals 
Chain Rule Mensuration: Areas and Volumes 
Mixtures and Allegation Clocks and Calendars 
Problems on Trains Pipes and Cisterns 
Races and Games Volume And Surface Area of Solid 
Profit and Loss Averages 
Cube Roots Time and Work 
Elementary Mathematics Ratio and Proportion 
Problems on ages Boats and Streams 
Variation Simplification 
H.C.F. and L.C.M Square Roots 
Arithmetic Discounts 
Simple Interest and Compound Interest  
 
 NCHMCT JEE Syllabus for English Language 
 
Below is some of the important topics that will be covered in the English Language section of 
NCHMCT JEE. 
 
Grammar Unseen Passages 
Passage Correction Word Formation 
Sentence Completion Theme detection 
Subject-Verb Agreement Idioms and Phrases 
Error Correction Sentence Correction 
Antonyms Conclusion 
Sentence Rearrangement Comprehension 
Synonyms Fill in the Blanks 
Vocabulary Tenses 
Articles Passage Completion 
Idioms and Phrases  
 
 
 
NCHMCT JEE Syllabus for General Knowledge & Current Affairs  
 
This section will cover questions from current affairs and important events. Some of the 
important topics of the GK section are provided below. 
 
Science – Inventions and Discoveries International Current Affairs 
Countries & Capitals etc Culture 
Abbreviations Important days 
Scientific Research Economics 
Knowledge of Current Events Sports 
Current events Indian Constitution 
History General Politics 
National Current Affairs India and its neighbouring countries 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 NCHMCT JEE Syllabus for Reasoning and Logical Deduction 
 
Reasoning and Logical Deduction section of NCHMCT JEE test the thinking ability of the 
candidates. Some of the important topics for the NCHMCT JEE Reasoning and Logical Deduction 
section are provided below 
 
Classification Non-Verbal Series 
Verbal Series Analogies 
Symbols and Notations Analytical Reasoning 
Problems Based on Symmetry Complex Arrangements 
Linear Arrangements Ordering & Sequencing 
Coding and Decoding Data Sufficiency Test 
Syllogism Routes & Networks 
Data Interpretation Test Direction and Distances 
Alphabet Test Blood Relationships 
Problems Based on Visual Ability  
 
 
 
NCHMCT JEE Syllabus for Aptitude for Service Sector
